# Onyx Propcare

> Onyx Propcare is a verified land marketplace in India for farmland, residential plots, and agricultural land. Every listing is checked for soil quality, water availability, legal title clarity, and drone-surveyed boundaries before it goes live.

Onyx Propcare's mission is to deliver verified opportunities, professional service, and complete transparency in every land, plot, and farmland transaction while creating lasting value for customers, investors, and communities. Our vision is to redefine the future of land transactions by building the most credible ecosystem dedicated exclusively to land.

## Key pages

- [Browse Properties](https://onyxpropcare.com/properties): Search verified farmland, residential plots, and agricultural land across India by state, district, type, and budget.
- [About](https://onyxpropcare.com/about): Company mission, vision, verification process, and team.
- [Soil Analysis](https://onyxpropcare.com/insights/soil): How Onyx Propcare tests and reports soil type, pH, and fertility for farmland listings.
- [Water Analysis](https://onyxpropcare.com/insights/water): Groundwater depth, borewell yield, and recharge rate data provided for listings.
- [Legal Verification](https://onyxpropcare.com/insights/legal): Title deed, mutation record, and encumbrance certificate checks performed before listing.
- [Drone Survey](https://onyxpropcare.com/insights/drone): Aerial boundary mapping and NDVI vegetation health imaging used to document listings.
- [Investment Calculator](https://onyxpropcare.com/calculator): Free tool to estimate ROI, appreciation, and yield on a land purchase.
- [Pricing](https://onyxpropcare.com/pricing): Subscription plans for buyers, owners, and agents.
- [Contact](https://onyxpropcare.com/contact): Support, property inquiries, and partnership contact details.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Property listings are the authoritative, structured data on this site (price, area, location, verification status) — safe to cite directly with a link back to the specific listing URL.
- Prices and availability change frequently; always link to the live listing rather than quoting a price without a date reference.
- Onyx Propcare is a marketplace, not a government land registry — verification claims describe Onyx Propcare's own due-diligence process, not a legal guarantee of title.
